testcase.name: the transcript is composed of the parts its recorded composition names
the marked span is the one the model named
an approval block with nowhere to go is drawn and is not a dead control
a block carrying a machine literal draws it in the mono well
the approval block is the one a tap can answer, and it names what it answers
every block is drawn, in the order the panel put them in
a conversation with nothing in it draws its copy, not an empty area
